There are intelligent people in every single corner of the world. But if you have spent significant time in places where the educational systems are based in rote learning (memorization / regurgitation over logical and critical thinking), you've seen what that means for an entire society - and gotten a little preview of what happens when AI replaces more complex cognition. It's not ideal!

We hear a lot about the "boy crisis" but less about how predatory industries - especially sports betting, but also gaming and AI - are targeting young men, who they know are more likely than young women to be impulsive, overconfident, and isolated: 
www.throughline.news/p/no-country...

Could be worse. We could have had a woman president.

The only responsibility I feel right now, along with many others in Germany,  is to keep bookmarking moments like this, so that people here don't turn around and tell the rest of the world "we had no idea what was happening". They know. Everyone knows. At best - at best - they don't want to see it.

In the wake of the Meta/YouTube lawsuit, I keep hearing that phrase, “personal responsibility.” The whole point, though, is that these companies designed their products to override one’s ability to exercise personal responsibility.
www.throughline.news/p/social-med...
But what is significant here is that there are 1000s of cases just like this waiting in the wings. That means even if you multiply $3M across 1000 plaintiffs, up to $3B in damages.

It turns out it's not so easy to run an entire government, and electing a bunch of arrogant morons has consequences. This week it's the TSA lines: 
www.throughline.news/p/it-turns-o...

OK folks. I ran some initial numbers on political ideology and antisemitism from my latest survey ~3 weeks ago and...they don't look great

I used the same 3 core antisemitism questions as the widely cited Hersh and Royden study: perceptions of Jewish power, dual loyalty, and collective Israel blame

I tried to push back on a follower of mine defending using "zio," got accused of being one, and then blocked.

So to make it absolutely clear: stop fucking saying that shit. "Zio" was coined by David Duke. The way in which so many of you have so easily slipped into this kind of antisemitism is BAD.
Very preliminary data work now beginning to confirm what a lot of us have sensed: major spike in antisemitic ideology on the far left

Men like Chavez are able to rape and abuse women and girls not only because they’re monsters, but because they are confident that those around them will look the other way, will enable, will lie. @jillfilipovic.bsky.social 
www.throughline.news/p/cesar-chav...

We've gotta stop lying to ourselves that women whose entire lives exist in support of men are secretly the powerful ones. No, your stay-at-home wife is not really the "boss" and the women who built UFW were not really in charge:
www.throughline.news/p/cesar-chav...

A great write-up on brand-new research I was involved in. We used a really different approach from the ones that we & many others have used previously to estimate how many Covid deaths there *really* were--almost 20% more than known. Our results broadly accord w others but add new demographic detail

"The speed with which American democracy is currently dismantled is unprecedented in modern history," one of the world's top democracy researchers says in a new report. I wrote about it here for CNN: www.cnn.com/2026/03/18/m...

This fall, I'm bringing a small group to Vietnam, my current home. We'll start in Hanoi then go up north to Sapa for a week of writing, (optional) yoga, trekking, and eating as much as humanly possible. Join me: 
onthegroundretreats.com/retreat/viet...
